peaks.lyric: 我们都是渺小真实存在
peaks.reference_action: Iris opens fully onto the solitary dark planet; vocal enters as rain begins to fall from a tiny storm cloud onto the lonely protagonist.
peaks.remake_action: Song-dynasty moon-gate iris opens onto a misty ink-wash island (披麻皴 & 苔点); silver ink rain threads fall onto Ink-Scholar Clawd beneath a dark ink cloud.

peaks.lyric: 眼睛里看到的都是广袤无垠的大海
peaks.reference_action: Extreme close-up of sparkling eyes transitions to a wide shot of both characters watching a golden sunrise over a boundless ocean, ending in a diagonal brush wipe at 15.5s.
peaks.remake_action: Close-up of eyes reflecting rolling Song-dynasty waves (INK.wave) pulls back to both characters watching a giant vermilion sun (朱砂日轮) rise over an ink-and-gold sea, stamped with a vermilion seal before an ink brush sweep.

peaks.lyric: 你让我学会如何拨开阴霾
peaks.reference_action: Both characters push apart the dark storm clouds, toss the umbrella aside, and embrace under warm golden sunlight.
peaks.remake_action: In festive Red Papercut (剪纸) & Ink contrast, both characters part the dark ink storm clouds with their hands, folding the Jiangnan oiled-paper umbrella as a golden 团花 sun blooms overhead.

peaks.reference_action: Colorful fireworks burst in rapid succession across the night sky while both characters watch side by side.
peaks.remake_action: On a backlit Shadow-Puppet (皮影) oil-lamp stage, translucent dyed-hide fireworks (朱红/石绿/藤黄/群青) burst and bloom above the two jointed leather puppets.

peaks.reference_action: After the single central firework fades and the partner vanishes, a dark blue ocean tide rises up the screen, submerging the protagonist up to its eyes.
peaks.remake_action: Towering multi-layered Song-dynasty ink waves (INK.wave) surge upward across the rice paper, submerging Ink-Scholar Clawd in deep indigo-ink water.

peaks.lyric: 爱炙热的你却忘了爱自己
peaks.reference_action: The floating heart breaks; a warm golden self-love light ignites inside the protagonist's chest as the camera pulls back to the tiny planet in starry space and irises out.
peaks.remake_action: The fractured crimson papercut heart scatters into plum petals; a warm golden-vermilion inner lantern (心灯) ignites in Ink-Scholar Clawd's chest as the camera pulls back to the solitary ink island in the starry宣纸 cosmos and irises out.
